name: moj-economy
note: Economy mode: r9-two-step as frozen and confirmed on the first sealed run (commit 9be7b751). Round 9. Two System-1 steps: step 1 answers (commit) or abstains; step 2, for abstained pairs only, reads the terrain and picks the design (stay with System 1 on writing, reference first on reasoning then the System-2 verdict if still under the stop, System-2 verdict elsewhere). Thresholds fitted on the tuning half: the cheapest setting whose cross-fitted tuning accuracy is within 0.5 point of the best (commit 0.8, reference stop 0.6).
